bullets.text: Spring Statement 2026 Insights - The Chancellor's low-key statement signals significant changes for small businesses starting April 2026.
MTD: A Game Changer - Making Tax Digital for Income Tax transforms tax compliance into a daily routine for small businesses.
AI Workflow Improvement - Focus on fixing one repetitive task with AI to enhance efficiency and save time.
New MTD Penalty Regime - HMRC's new penalty systems for MTD aim to encourage timely submissions rather than just penalise mistakes.
Embedded Accounting Rise - Financial institutions are prioritising embedded accounting to meet small business needs for seamless experiences.
Preparing Landlords for MTD - Accountants must ready landlord clients for MTD as it impacts many with rental income starting April 2026.
AI Without Risk - A practical roadmap helps businesses safely implement AI by improving one workflow at a time.
